title: Maintenance Chorus: SLO-preserving node lifecycle orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a coordinated maintenance orchestration ("Maintenance Chorus") for Dedicated fleets that performs node lifecycle operations (drain, software upgrades, firmware updates, decommission) while preserving per-customer throughput contracts and latency SLOs. The feature must integrate with autoscaling policies and the throughput reservation system so that evictions and prewarming do not violate service guarantees. Deliverables: 1) choreography engine that schedules staggered drain waves by throughput lanes; 2) autoscaler hedging extension to provision temporary burst capacity before drains; 3) KV-cache prewarm and warmup handshake on reintegration; 4) rollback-safe drain protocol with transparent re-routing and graceful bleed-off; 5) operational observability (per-customer SLO delta, drain telemetry, reheating metrics). Acceptance criteria: - No SLO miss attributable to scheduled maintenance in 95% of synthetic workload tests at 3x tail pressure. - Drains complete without >5% sustained error-rate regression for affected tenants. - KV-cache hit-rate returns to baseline within 10 minutes of reintegration in 90% of runs. - Autoscaler hedging triggers and tears down capacity within configured budget bounds.
comments: 2026-03-10 AP: Kickoff meeting; aligned on scope and acceptance criteria. Noted risk: autoscaler race with staggered drains when node replacements come from the same pool.

2026-03-11 MN: Prototype of staggered drain planner completed. Planner assigns nodes into 'chorus slices' by tenant throughput weight and locality. Submitted initial PR for planner module (link above).

2026-03-11 JT: Design review feedback from runtime team: require an explicit KV prewarm handshake to avoid cold-cache penalty; suggested preheat window of 30s before traffic shift. Added to design doc.

2026-03-12 MN: Ran synthetic stress test (tail-pressure scenario). Observed 7% transient token-latency SLO blips during reintegration when autoscaler did not hedge. Investigating autoscaler tuning and quota reservation interplay.

2026-03-12 AP: Decided trade-offs: prioritize customer throughput contracts over aggressive bin-packing during maintenance windows; will surface cost delta per maintenance wave in console. Next: implement autoscaler hedging and add per-tenant reservation checks in planner.
2026-03-12 MN: Created follow-up tasks: ENG-1001210 (autoscaler-hedging-extension), ENG-1001211 (kv-prewarm-handshake), ENG-1001212 (maintenance-wave-dashboard).
2026-03-12 AP: Added test plan outline for QA: phased canary runs on non-critical fleets, then progressive rollout to larger customers with read-only traffic mirrors before full drain.
